observations.title: Session summary
observations.content:
## Goal
Start US-01 Crear proyecto using SDD, implement the first slices, and commit work with TDD evidence.

## Instructions
- User requested SDD/OpenSpec artifacts in Spanish.
- User wants TDD evidence recorded in commits.

- The repo initially had no CodeGraph index; it was initialized locally and `.codegraph/` is ignored.
- System Go was unavailable; Go 1.27.1 was installed user-locally under `~/.local/share/go-toolchains/go1.27.1` with symlinks in `~/.local/bin`.
- Docker exists but the current user cannot access `/var/run/docker.sock`; testcontainers PostgreSQL tests skip with a clear permission-denied message.
- The user confirmed PostgreSQL/psql, HTTP API, SQL versioned migrations, `pgx`, and `testcontainers-go`.

## Accomplished
- ✅ Created Spanish SDD artifacts for US-01: proposal, spec with GIVEN/WHEN/THEN scenarios, design, tasks, and apply progress.
- ✅ Implemented US-01 slice 1: Project domain, CreateProjectUseCase, ProjectRepository interface, and `net/http` handler for `POST /projects`.
- ✅ Implemented US-01 slice 2 infrastructure: PostgreSQL migrations, `PostgresProjectRepository` using pgx, and testcontainers integration test scaffold.
- ✅ Created commits with TDD evidence in commit messages:
  - `8788092 chore: initialize Go project skeleton`
  - `3c052b9 feat(project): add create project domain and HTTP`
  - `400f190 feat(project): add PostgreSQL project repository`
  - `1fcef97 docs(sdd): record US-01 artifacts and TDD progress`
- ✅ Verified `go test ./...` and `git diff --check` pass.
- 🔲 Real PostgreSQL integration execution remains blocked by Docker permissions.
- 🔲 Runtime API composition with DB config and UUID generator is still pending.

## Next Steps
- Fix Docker permissions or provide an accessible Docker daemon, then rerun `go test -v ./internal/project/infrastructure/postgres` and ensure tests do not skip.
- Decide runtime config/UUID composition and wire `cmd/api/main.go` to PostgreSQL-backed `POST /projects`.
- Continue SDD verify/archive after blockers are resolved.
